announcements.headline: Appointment of Chief Financial Officer
announcements.insight: Hvivo appoints a new CFO following earlier succession notices in September. This board change may influence post-acquisition governance.

announcements.headline: Board Changes
announcements.insight: Board changes follow the CFO succession in September. Shareholders should monitor governance stability.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim results follow the CFO succession in September. Shareholders should watch for financial performance updates.

announcements.headline: Chief Financial Officer Succession
announcements.insight: Hvivo announces a CFO succession. This follows its acquisition of CRS Berlin in August and results notice in September.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
announcements.insight: A notice of results is issued. Shareholders should watch for the actual financial data release following the consultancy and acquisition announcements.

announcements.headline: hVIVO acquires CRS Berlin
announcements.insight: hVIVO acquires CRS Berlin. This follows a consultancy contract in June and an auditor change in July.

announcements.headline: Change of Auditor
announcements.insight: Hvivo appoints a new auditor. This follows a consultancy contract in June 2026. Shareholders should monitor for further governance updates.

announcements.headline: Consultancy contract with Decoy Therapeutics
announcements.insight: Hvivo has entered a consultancy contract with Decoy Therapeutics. Shareholders should monitor for further details regarding the scope and potential commercial implications of this partnership.
